coverage: Every nonempty frontend .ui shortcut plus Linux setShortcut/setShortcuts assignments (including preview nudges) from OBS 32.2.2, and five documented preview gestures. Configurable frontend actions have no universal recording/streaming hotkey; refresh reads the active profile and scene collection. Excludes inherited Qt editing keys, arbitrary widget key handlers and plugin-provided defaults.
